issues.jp_before: 一人[ひとり]で旅行[りょこう]に行[い]くと言[い]ったら、母[はは]に{心配[しんぱい]されました|pt-passive}。
issues.problem: Distractor 心配させました (母に心配させました, 'I made my mother worry') describes the same event and fits the English almost as well.
issues.action: Replaced the distractor with 心配してあげました and rewrote the why.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]が「僕[ぼく]にも運転[うんてん]の練習[れんしゅう]を{させて|pt-sasete}」と父[ちち]に頼[たの]んだ。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item where the speaker asks Dad and is allowed to drive the car (same verb and situation).
issues.action: Changed the activity to walking the dog and updated the English and the why.

issues.jp_before: 料理[りょうり]が好[す]きなので、母[はは]に頼[たの]んで夕飯[ゆうはん]を{作[つく]らせてもらった|pt-sasete}。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the item asking Mum to let me make dinner (作らせてください) in the same file.
issues.action: Rewrote it as 母に頼んで、自分の部屋の壁を青く塗らせてもらった, with distractors in the same form.

issues.jp_before: 店[みせ]の前[まえ]に、誰[だれ]かが飲[の]み{かけの|pt-kiru}ペットボトルが置[お]いてあった。
issues.problem: 誰かが does not fit the noun-modifier 飲みかけの + 置いてあった; it should be 誰かの.
issues.action: Changed it to 誰かの and changed the English to "Someone's half-drunk plastic bottle".

issues.jp_before: 若[わか]いころ、家族[かぞく]を養[やしな]うために働[はたら]き{ぬいた|pt-kiru}父[ちち]は、今[いま]も倹約[けんやく]を忘[わす]れない。
issues.problem: Distractor 働きっぱなしの ('the father who worked non-stop') is close to the meaning of the English; the English 'hasn't forgotten thrift' is unnatural.
issues.action: Replaced the distractor with っぱなしにした (ungrammatical with the intransitive 働く); the English now says 'is still careful with money'.
